questions.q: What kind of mentorship does the summary recommend?
a: An informal friendship, not a paid program
A formal contract with clear goals
A paid coach with a fixed schedule
A distant expert you rarely meet
questions.why: Lesson 1 says informal mentors are more invested in your success.

questions.q: Why does informal mentorship work better?
a: Mentors invest more when they feel personally connected
Friends are always cheaper than coaches
Formal mentors usually lack experience
Friends are more willing to criticise you
questions.why: Lesson 1 says personal connection makes mentors stick with you through hard times.

questions.q: What did Michelle Phan do after her Lady Gaga makeup video took off?
a: She made more videos recreating popular looks
She stopped posting to protect her lead
She switched to fashion modelling
She sold her channel to a network
questions.why: Lesson 2 says she doubled down with Catwoman, Disney and Burton looks.

questions.q: What does the summary mean by good timing?
a: Hitting the right nerve at the right moment
Posting on a fixed weekly schedule
Waiting until conditions are perfect
Copying whatever is trending that day
questions.why: Lesson 2 says you cannot predict a hit, but you can time your efforts.

questions.q: Why aim for a 10x improvement instead of 10%?
a: It forces you to rethink everything from scratch
It is cheaper and faster to test
It keeps risk low and steady
It needs less imagination from teams
questions.why: Lesson 3 says moonshots break limited thinking and demand fresh approaches.
